usedFor: DonorPerfect holds donors and gifts, and “Create or Update Donor” and “Create or Update Gift” keep both current.

bestTemplate.name: “Create or Update Gift” in DonorPerfect
bestTemplate.why: It records a gift with donor, date and amount, or updates an existing one by Gift ID.

watchOut: “Create or Update Gift” updates a gift when given a Gift ID, so check the ID is right.
